answer: AI agents cataloging cultural works, from a sonnet to an onyx relic, resist Sybil attacks using proof of space. Registrants must allocate cryptographic storage plots on disk and solve rapid retrieval challenges. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of dedicating physical storage capacity per identity, checking the tide of forged nodes. However, adversaries with vast idle disk arrays can repurpose existing hardware at near-zero marginal cost.
